chunks: He said: Al-Mudhaffar ibn Muhammad al-Balkhi reported to me. He said: Muhammad ibn Hammam Abu Ali narrated to us. He said: Hamid ibn Ziyad narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Ubaidullah ibn Hayyan narrated to us. He said: al-Rabee' ibn Sulaiman narrated to us, from Ismail ibn Muslim al-Sakooni, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon them.

He said: I heard the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his progeny, say: "Act according to what God has made obligatory upon you, and you will be the most God-fearing of people. Be content with what God has apportioned to you, and you will be the richest of people. Refrain from what God has forbidden, and you will be the most pious of people. Be good to your neighbours, and you will be a believer. Be a good companion to those who accompany you, and you will be a Muslim."

key_terms.فرائض الله: Obligations of God - the mandatory duties prescribed by Allah
key_terms.مؤمنا: A believer - one with true faith
key_terms.محارم الله: Forbidden things of God - what Allah has prohibited
key_terms.مسلما: A Muslim - one who submits to God

ai.seo_question: What are the five qualities that define a true Muslim according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWA) delivers five concise pieces of wisdom: fulfilling divine obligations makes one the most God-fearing, contentment with God's provision makes one the richest, avoiding the forbidden makes one the most pious, being a good neighbour makes one a true believer, and being a good companion makes one a true Muslim. This hadith is narrated through the Imams from the prophetic lineage.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Al-Mudhaffar ibn Muhammad al-Balkhi reported to me from Muhammad ibn Hammam Abu ‘Ali, who reported from Hamid ibn Ziyad, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Ubaidullah ibn Hayyan, who reported from al-Rabee’ ibn Sulaiman, from Ismail ibn Muslim al-Sakooni from al-Sadiq Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:

I heard the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, say: "Act according to what Allah had made obligatory upon you, and you will be the most God-fearing; and be content with what Allah has apportioned to you, and you will be the richest of all, and refrain from what Allah has forbidden, and you will be the most pious, and do good to your neighbours, and you will be (true) believer, and be a good companion and you will be a (good) Muslim."
